note: Runs written before D-033 and D-034 that assert completeness they do not have. They are not repairable and not deletable (D-002). Listed here so tooling reports them honestly rather than either failing forever or pretending they are fine. Never add a run to this list to make a check pass — see the rule below.
rule: A run belongs here only if it is frozen (finished_at set) AND was written by a version of persistRun that could close an unverified run. Nothing written by scan-supabase can qualify: it verifies before closing, so a run written since D-033 is either complete or still open.
